validationResults.name: helmfile-template-production
validationResults.details: Helmfile template missing Istio resources for production
validationResults.difference: Production helmfile template does not render VirtualService or DestinationRule resources. Root cause: helmfile.yaml does not reference production-specific values files (devbob.production.values.yaml, metabob-rpc-api.production.values.yaml). Only environment-level values are loaded, but chart-level istio.enabled flag is not set.

diagnosis.issue: Production chart values not loaded by helmfile
diagnosis.rootCause: helmfile.yaml releases do not include production-specific values files
diagnosis.currentBehavior: Only charts/devbob.values.yaml is loaded (istio.enabled=false by default)
diagnosis.expectedBehavior: Should also load charts/devbob.production.values.yaml when environment=production
diagnosis.fix: Update helmfile.yaml to conditionally load production values files per release
